channel.title: Where would I publish work about regular human characters?
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Where would I publish work about regular human characters?" - I would like to know where I would I publish work about regular human characters, specifically a task force I intend to make proper characters for a tale series I'm planning.

item.title: Re: Where would I publish work about regular human characters?
item.content:encoded:
I want to know if there's a place for this or if this is to be kept solely in the tales and not have a description page

If you're looking to just have an overview of laundry-list information and statistics pertaining to recurring character, the closest the site has is a series hub page. For example, the Kiryu Labs Hub.

That said, if you want to have a hub page, you need to have tales to populate the hub first.
